en: ...Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's...back to normal?
<CLT=cltMIND>Did Monokuma...clean everything up?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's usually for when something bad
happens... I hope it stays off.

<CLT=cltMIND>The books are packed
together tightly...

<CLT=cltMIND>Some of these books have nice bindings.
It would be a shame to leave them here...
<CLT=cltMIND>There are books in various languages...

<CLT=cltMIND>Even some languages I've never seen
before. What country are these from?

<CLT=cltMIND>These are some expert-level textbooks...
I wonder if someone was using them?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder when Kaede came up with her
plan. How long was she carrying that burden?

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro noticed the trick to this bookcase.
Just like me...

<CLT=cltMIND>The only difference between me and him...
is that I had someone I could trust.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what I would've done...
if Kaede hadn't been there...
<CLT=cltMIND>What an unusual globe...

<CLT=cltMIND>If only I had realized that
Kaede was acting strangely...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe things wouldn't...
have ended up this way...
